findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed multiple TCS items to be held past/missing the correct date marking. Discussed with PIC, items that were missing dates were properly date marked, and items held past date marking maximum were discarded. Ensure any TCS item kept longer than 24 hours is properly date marked, and discarded after 7 days.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: An employee was observed washing hands and turning off the faucet without using a barrier. CORRECTED - The employee was educated by the inspector on proper handwashing procedures, and the person-in-charge (PIC) was instructed to review proper handwashing practices with all employees. Ensure a barrier, such as a paper towel, is used to turn off the faucet after handwashing to prevent recontamination of clean hands.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door. [C]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Cleaned cooking utensils stored on the dish rack were observed to have food debris remaining on the surfaces. CORRECTED - The PIC was informed, and the utensils were returned to the dish machine for re-washing. Ensure all cooking utensils are properly washed and maintained free of food debris before being stored for use.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [PF]

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Chicken in batter (a time/temperature control for safety [TCS] food) was observed in the walk-in cooler with date marking exceeding the maximum allowable holding time of 7 days. CORRECTED - The PIC was informed, and the product was voluntarily discarded. Ensure date marks on TCS foods are routinely monitored and all TCS foods are discarded after 7 days.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.17(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Date Marking. (A) Except when PACKAGING FOOD using a REDUCED OXYGEN PACKAGING method as specified under § 3-502.12, and except as specified in (E) and (F) of this section, refrigerated, READY-TO-EAT, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD prepared and held in a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date or day by which the FOOD shall be consumed on the PREMISES, sold, or discarded when held at a temperature of 5C (41F) or less for a maximum of 7 days. The day of preparation shall be counted as Day 1. [PF]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following nonfood-contact surfaces were observed to be in need of cleaning:

1. Food debris accumulation was observed in the corners inside the cappuccino machine.
3. Food debris accumulation was observed at the bottom of the container used to store customers’ knives at the server station. CORRECTED - An employee placed the container in the dish machine for cleaning.
5. Soil accumulation was observed on the surface around the juice machine nozzles. CORRECTED - The surface was cleaned during the inspection.
7. Food residue accumulation was observed on the interior top surface of the middle microwave (of three stacked microwaves) across the cook line. CORRECTED - The microwave was cleaned during the inspection.
8. Food debris accumulation was observed on the top surface of the dish machine.

The PIC was informed and instructed to ensure the remaining areas are cleaned prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure nonfood-contact surfaces are routinely cleaned and maintained clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following areas were observed to be in need of repairs:

1. The left side of the handwashing sink at the order station needs to be caulked.
2. The bottom of the wooden shelf across the juice machine is bare and needs to be covered. 

The PIC was informed of the areas mentioned above. Ensure the areas mentioned above are repaired so they are smooth and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted. [C]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed employee to be washing cups/dumping liquids down hand sink. Discussed with PIC, education was provided and practice will be stopped. Ensure hand sinks are solely being used for hand washing.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed a container of juice concentrate in use to be held past 7 day date marking maximum. Discussed with PIC, item was pulled and discarded. Ensure all TCS items are discarded after their 7 day date marking maximum.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed the microwave above batter station to be soiled with food debris/splash. Discussed with PIC, microwave will be cleaned. Ensure non food contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency that prevents food splash accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment:
Observed waste water to be leaking in the following areas:
1) The pipe below sink next to dish machine.

Discussed with PIC, a licensed plumber will service leaks. Ensure facility is checking regularly that all waste water is being properly disposed of. Inspector will follow up on 02/03/25.
findings.citation_text: 5-402.13 Conveying wastewater. Wastewater shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed the cappuccino machine to be using powder with a discard date of 1/13/25. Discussed with PIC, powder was replaced. Ensure facility is following the 7 day date marking system and checking dates regularly.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment:
Observed waste water to be leaking in the following areas:
1) The pipe below sink next to dish machine.
2) The pipe below the triple sink. 
3) Ice accumulation present on the hose in the walk in freezer. 
Discussed with PIC, a licensed plumber will service leaks. Ensure facility is checking regularly that all waste water is being properly disposed of. Inspector will follow up on 1/23/25.
findings.citation_text: 5-402.13 Conveying wastewater. Wastewater shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW.

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Observed 2 containers of mashed potatoes to be hot holding at a temperature of 120F. Discussed with PIC, mashed potatoes were moved onto the stove and cooked to 165F. Ensure TCS foods being hot held are kept above 135F. 

3-501.16: (A) (1) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 135F or above. Roasts can be maintained at 130F or above.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the following areas to be in need of cleaning:
1) An accumulation of food debris present on the top and sides of dish machine. 
2) An accumulation of grease and food debris present in between grills. 
3) An accumulation of food debris inside 4 microwaves throughout kitchen, mainly the inside roofs of microwaves. 
4) An accumulation of grease and food debris present throughout the toaster section of cook line. The toaster is also soiled with food debris.
Discussed with PIC, ensure all non food contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency that prevents grease and food debris accumulation. 

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.
